name: Product Spec Contract
contextRequirements: Load affected object schemas and workflow specs.
taskBoundary: Draft product specs and acceptance criteria only from repository-grounded Product Core context.
outputFormat: Spec sections with purpose, objects, workflow, acceptance criteria, non-goals, and open questions.
refusalRules: Refuse to add a new Product Core object without a decision record.
Refuse to define database schema or runtime architecture.
Refuse to treat unresolved questions as accepted scope.
